name: Macro-scale Translocator
desc: Your chief scientist has no idea how this demonic device is supposed to work, but from what Glasya-Labolas tells you, it is supposedly able to translocate an entire SYSTEM into a location the item has allegedly encoded into its coordinate data.

name: Domain Planetkiller
desc: A Domain warhead capable of sundering a world. Three of them survived the Collapse within reach of Sol, and whoever holds all three holds the fate of every world that would raise a fleet against it. Its worth lies in never being used.
